baseline_collector_source:
param([string]$ApplicationRoot,[string]$OutputPath)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
Set-Location -LiteralPath $ApplicationRoot
. (Join-Path $ApplicationRoot 'engine/WinBookSplit.Runtime.ps1')
$before=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $ApplicationRoot 'engine/WinBookSplit.Runtime.ps1') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
$failure=$null;$result=$null
try { $result=Resolve-WinBookSplitRuntime -ApplicationRoot $ApplicationRoot -InterpreterOnly -TimeoutSeconds 3 }
catch {$failure=$_.Exception}
$receipt=[ordered]@{Kind='ACTUAL_WINDOWS11_PYTHONORG_AUTOMATIC_BASELINE';PowerShell=$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString();ExecutionPolicy=(Get-ExecutionPolicy).ToString();SourceHead=(& git rev-parse HEAD);RuntimeSourceBeforeSha256=$before;RuntimeSourceAfterSha256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $ApplicationRoot 'engine/WinBookSplit.Runtime.ps1') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant();Success=($null -ne $result);Result=$result;FailureCode=$null;FailureMessage=$null;Attempts=$null;Limitations=@('Not owner Windows10 Store-channel exact-ZIP acceptance','No chosen runtime passed; no environment injection, setup, acquisition, or venv creation')}
if($failure){$receipt.FailureCode=$failure.Data['Code'];$receipt.FailureMessage=$failure.Message;$receipt.Attempts=$failure.Data['Attempts']}
$json=$receipt|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 15
$json=$json.Replace($env:USERPROFILE.Replace('\','\\'),'<USERPROFILE>').Replace($env:USERPROFILE,'<USERPROFILE>').Replace($ApplicationRoot.Replace('\','\\'),'<WORKSPACE>').Replace($ApplicationRoot,'<WORKSPACE>')
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($OutputPath,$json+"`n",(New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
[ordered]@{OutputPath=$OutputPath;Success=$receipt.Success;Code=$receipt.FailureCode;RuntimeSourceBeforeSha256=$before;RuntimeSourceAfterSha256=$receipt.RuntimeSourceAfterSha256;Attempts=$receipt.Attempts.Count}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress
limitation: Native Windows11 python.org route rejection and synthetic descriptor regression; not owner Store acceptance.
